unit.title: Seva, the Golden Temple, and Gratitude

lesson.title: Review Day: A Week of Gratitude
lesson.subject: sikhi

contentBlocks.text: This week you went deeper into Seva, the Golden Temple, and prayer than ever before. Let's review it all!

Quick review: Langar needs many real jobs — cooking, serving, washing dishes — all equally important (Day 1). The Golden Temple sits in a pool called the Amrit Sarovar, connected by a causeway (Day 2). Ardas is a shared, standing prayer of thanks and guidance (Day 3). Gratitude connects all of this — in action, in place, and in words (Day 4). Name one new thing you learned this week about each: Langar, the Golden Temple, and prayer.
Wonderful work these past two weeks! You've gone from simple introductions to real, specific understanding of Seva, the Golden Temple, and prayer.

objectives: Review and connect this week's four lessons: Langar jobs, the Amrit Sarovar, Ardas, gratitude as a theme
Recall one new specific fact learned this week about each of the three threads
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Do the quick walk-through review of all 4 days together, out loud.
2. Have the child name one new fact learned this week about each thread.
3. Complete the review worksheet.
4. Celebrate finishing two full weeks of Grade 1 Sikhi — real depth beyond the introductions!
differentiationTips: Struggling: focus on just one thread the child engaged with most this week, rather than requiring all three
Ready for more: ask the child to explain how this week's content connects back to something from week 1
This is a good checkpoint to note which of the three threads (Langar, Golden Temple, or prayer) needs the most reinforcement
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is a recall and review activity — check that the child can state one new specific fact about Langar jobs, the Amrit Sarovar, and Ardas, each learned this week.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Consolidates this week's deepened Seva, Golden Temple, and prayer content before the course continues, matching the 'consolidate before adding more' pacing established across this session.
